summary: Overnight courier hold for encrypted engineering laptop + request for escorted secure swap and temporary badge
description:
Issue summary:
Courier (PolarFreight #PF-77890) reported that an encrypted engineering laptop (asset tag RW-ENG-9921) is being held at the offsite sorting facility overnight due to a signature mismatch and category-3 handling requirement. The laptop contains customer-facing model evaluation data and must be returned to the secure swap room in Building 7 for on-site handoff.

Impact:
- Blocked: One senior ML engineer cannot access work laptop; sprint blocker for a scheduled demo tomorrow morning.
- Security: Asset contains evaluation data that requires escorted transfer and audit trail.
- Facilities: Need temporary physical access (escort and temp badge) for courier and engineer to do exchange outside normal hours.

Environment:
- Office: Redwood HQ campus, Building 7 secure swap room (Ground floor, keycard zone C).
- Courier: PolarFreight contract (overnight hold at SFO sorting center).
- Asset: RW-ENG-9921, encrypted SSD, shipped in company white Pelican case.

Steps to reproduce / chronology:
1. 2026-03-12 18:42 PST - Engineer handed laptop to PolarFreight for same-day return; tracking PF-77890.
2. 2026-03-12 21:10 PST - PolarFreight updated: "Held for signature - category-3 asset". Attempted delivery aborted.
3. 2026-03-12 21:45 PST - Engineer opened SUPP ticket with PolarFreight; their agent requests on-site contact and ID verification.
4. 2026-03-13 09:05 PST - Facilities alerted to need for escorted after-hours handoff; security requires temporary badge and escort for the courier.

Courier logs / tracking excerpts:
- PF tracking: https://polarfreight.example/track/PF-77890 (internal link)
- Carrier note: "Held at SFO hub - awaiting verified recipient and facility escort. No access to dock after 20:00 without escort."

Requested outcome / acceptance criteria:
- Confirmed escorted transfer window tonight between 20:30-22:00 PST with PolarFreight and Redwood Security present.
- Temporary one-use badge issued to PolarFreight driver limited to Building 7 swap room, valid for 60 minutes, recorded by campus access logs.
- Engineer receives replacement loaner (asset RW-LOAN-1102) if handoff cannot be completed tonight.
- Inventory updated and chain-of-custody recorded in Confluence audit page.

Notes on constraints:
- Security policy requires two-person handoff for category-3 assets and a signed form (see Confluence: /pages/secure-asset-handoff).
- Facilities can provide escort until 22:30 local time; beyond that requires duty security which is limited.
- If courier requires customs paperwork (international parcels), a different protocol applies — not currently indicated by carrier notes.
comments: 2026-03-13 09:20 - Jordan Lee (Facilities): I spoke with PolarFreight local ops. They can attempt delivery tonight 20:30-21:30 but require a named on-site contact and ID check at the dock. Requested driver name and ETA; awaiting response.

2026-03-13 10:05 - Nina Ortiz (Security): Can issue a one-time guest badge restricted to Building 7 swap room. I need the driver's full name and photo ID copy before we generate it. Security can escort from dock to swap room. Will schedule reserve for 20:15-21:00.

2026-03-13 11:12 - Priya Malhotra (Reporter): Uploaded scanned copy of PolarFreight booking confirmation and engineer's return authorization (Confluence link: /pages/returns/RW-ENG-9921). Engineer requests earliest possible swap tonight; can be present for ID verification.

2026-03-13 12:40 - Jordan Lee (Facilities): PolarFreight provided driver name: Marcus Hale; photo ID attached to carrier portal. I've asked Security to verify and generate temporary badge. Also reserved swap bench and signing tablet.

2026-03-13 17:05 - Nina Ortiz (Security): Verified driver ID via carrier photo; temp badge ready. Escort assigned: Officer T. Alvarez (on duty 20:00-22:00). Please confirm if engineer will be present at 20:30. Otherwise we'll fallback to loaner process.

2026-03-13 17:15 - Priya Malhotra (Reporter): Engineer confirmed availability at 20:30. Please include chain-of-custody form (digital signature) during handoff. Priya to be present as backup approver.
2026-03-13 20:05 - Jordan Lee (Facilities): PolarFreight ETA now 20:40. Escort and swap room prepped. Officer Alvarez en route to dock. Courier confirmed driver Marcus Hale on scene at 20:36.
investigation_notes: Initial hypothesis: signature mismatch occurred because courier attempted to deliver after standard hours and dock access requires escort for category-3 assets.
Checked past similar tickets: INT-108234 had same carrier restriction; procedure to request temporary badge and escort was used successfully.
Checked access logs for Building 7 dock (2026-03-12): no attempted delivery events recorded after 20:00; indicates carrier hold is at external hub, not on-campus.
Risk assessment: if handoff fails tonight, provide encrypted loaner and escalate to CTO for demo delay approval. Loaner must be wiped and reimaged after return.
resolution_notes: WORK IN PROGRESS: Tonight's escort confirmed and temp badge issued to Marcus Hale (one-use). Handoff window 20:40-21:00 completed — waiting for signed chain-of-custody upload from Security (expected 21:15).
If chain-of-custody not uploaded by 21:45, proceed with loaner issuance RW-LOAN-1102 and notify engineering leadership. Inventory team to mark RW-ENG-9921 as 'in-transit, held' until audit complete.

Post-action items: 1) Add PolarFreight contract clause to vendor onboarding to allow pre-approved ID exchange for category-3 assets; 2) Update Confluence runbook with step-by-step for overnight holds and include template for signed handoff. Assigned to Jordan Lee and Nina Ortiz (due 2026-03-20).
